name: The Tower of Goddess
source:
Welcome to your NEXT FAVORITE TV SHOW
Here you will follow the Hot adventure of Thiago who decided to play a mysterious Tv show were a guy needs to beat womens at games.
But he needs to be careful because at the end of each one the winner can punish the looser and humiliate him, amically or sexually.
